description_en: Create a copy of a file or folder in the cloud drive
description_zh: 为网盘中的文件或文件夹制作一个副本
kebab_example: aliyun ecd copy-cds-file --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cds-id cn-hangzhou+cds-3522820000 --file-id 640985a0ca2f71f489d2497682ca0bf468de0000 --end-user-id user01 --parent-folder-id root --auto-rename true --file-receiver-id user02 --file-receiver-type user --group-id cg-hs3i1w39o68ma0000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CopyCdsFile

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud disk
parameters.name: cds_id

parameters.help_en: The file ID. You can call the CreateCdsFile operation to query the file ID
parameters.help_zh: 文件的ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2247622.html接口查询对应文件的ID
parameters.name: file_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID that you want to use to access the cloud disk
parameters.name: end_user_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the parent folder of the folder to which you want to copy the file. If you want to copy the file to the root directory, set this parameter to root
parameters.help_zh: 复制目的地位置的父文件夹ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2247622.html接口查询对应文件的ID。当复制进根目录时，填`root`
parameters.name: parent_folder_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically rename the file if a file that has the same name exists in the folder to which you want to copy the file. Default value: false.

Valid values:

- true

  <!-- -->

  <!-- -->

  <!-- -->

- false

  <!-- -->

  <!-- -->

parameters.help_zh: 当目标文件夹下存在同名文件时，是否自动重命名
parameters.name: auto_rename

parameters.help_en:
目标复制文件所在的个人空间 ID（即 UserId，您可以在 DescribeCloudDriveUsers 接口返回的报文中获取。）或者目标复制文件所在的团队空间 ID（即 GroupId，您可以在 DescribeCloudDriveGroups 接口返回的报文中获取。）

> FileReceiverId 和 FileReceiverType 都为空时，默认复制到文件所在的个人空间
parameters.help_zh:
复制目的地所在的个人盘ID（可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2357237.html接口的返回参数`UserId`获取）或者团队空间ID（可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/609896.html接口的返回参数`GroupId`获取）。
> `FileReceiverId`和`FileReceiverType`都为空时，默认复制到文件当前所在的个人盘
parameters.name: file_receiver_id
